concurrency: Callback writes event,length,prefix before release-store completion. Poll reads callback fields only after acquire-exchange sees a completion and outstanding request.

A single command_pending request is enforced and remains held through timeout; no next command can replace callback fields before poll formats the current error. Exact dispatcher clears callback after invocation.
Raw HAL response prefix is a separate atomic uint32 witness. It is not used for command acceptance, completion, status, or routing snapshots.
Diagnostic string is formatted/read by the control poll thread; callbacks do not format strings, call file APIs, or log.

message_lifecycle: NFC_REJECT labels a well-formed matching callback with nonzero controller status; NFC_BAD_RSP labels malformed/wrong-event/wrong-opcode/notification callback.
fail→START_END→ERROR preserves diagnostic text; subsequent STOP can reportStopped while nfc_probe_diagnostic retains the response evidence.
Evidence resets only when next START passes preflight/discovery gates. Failed preflight and wrong-discovery-state attempts preserve it.
